turns.content: For a rhombohedral lattice with a=b=c=a and alpha=beta=gamma, write the reciprocal-metric formula for d_hkl. Here a=10 Angstrom and alpha=30 degrees, so the basis is nonorthogonal.
Evaluate sin^2(alpha), cos(alpha), cos^2(alpha), and cos^3(alpha) at 30 degrees.
Insert those values into the rhombohedral formula and calculate the numerator and denominator of 1/d_111^2.
Compute 1/d_111^2 and then d_111, including units.
Explain how the numerical numerator 0.0538476 and denominator 4.90381 Angstrom^2 enter the inverse-square calculation.
Recalculate d_111 from those two components as a consistency check.
Check the nonorthogonal metric, trigonometric substitutions, inverse-square step, and dimensions.
Report the final (111) spacing and the key rhombohedral-metric substitution.
